grid.title: Posição do Estoque Atual
grid.expression: SELECT PRO.CODPROD, PRO.AD_CODANTERIOR, PRO.DESCRPROD, PRO.CODVOL, NVL(SUM(EST.ESTOQUE),0) AS ESTOQUE, NVL(SUM(EST.RESERVADO),0) AS RESERVADO, NVL(SUM(EST.ESTOQUE) - SUM(EST.RESERVADO),0) AS SALDO, NVL(PRO.ESTMIN,0) AS ESTMIN, NVL(PRO.ESTMAX,0) AS ESTMAX, PAR.CODPARC || '-' || PAR.RAZAOSOCIAL AS FORN, PRO.LOCALIZACAO, --OBTEMCUSTO_SPARK (PRO.CODPROD,'S',1,'N',0,'N',' ',TRUNC(SYSDATE),1) AS CUSTOUNITMPGERENCIAL, CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT LMP.CODPRODMP FROM TPRLMP LMP INNER JOIN TGFPRO PRO2 ON(PRO2.CODPROD = LMP.CODPRODMP) INNER JOIN TPREFX EFX ON(EFX.IDEFX = LMP.IDEFX) INNER JOIN TGFLOC LOC ON(LOC.CODLOCAL = LMP.CODLOCALORIG) WHERE LMP.CODPRODMP = PRO.CODPROD AND (NVL(LMP.CONTROLEPA, ' ') = ' ' OR LMP.CONTROLEPA = ' ') AND (LMP.TIPOUSOMP IN ('N'))) THEN 'SIM' ELSE 'NÃO' END AS FICHA, CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT LMP.CODPRODMP FROM TPRLMP LMP INNER JOIN TGFPRO PRO2 ON(PRO2.CODPROD = LMP.CODPRODMP) INNER JOIN TPREFX EFX ON(EFX.IDEFX = LMP.IDEFX) INNER JOIN TGFLOC LOC ON(LOC.CODLOCAL = LMP.CODLOCALORIG) WHERE LMP.CODPRODMP = PRO.CODPROD AND (NVL(LMP.CONTROLEPA, ' ') = ' ' OR LMP.CONTROLEPA = ' ') AND (LMP.TIPOUSOMP IN ('N'))) THEN '#cfe2f3' ELSE '#fff2cc' END AS BKCOLOR, (SELECT NVL(SUM(ITE2.QTDNEG - ITE2.QTDENTREGUE),0) AS PENDENTE FROM TGFPRO PRO2 LEFT JOIN TGFITE ITE2 ON PRO2.CODPROD = ITE2.CODPROD LEFT JOIN TGFCAB CAB2 ON ITE2.NUNOTA = CAB2.NUNOTA LEFT JOIN TGFTOP TOP2 ON (CAB2.CODTIPOPER = TOP2.CODTIPOPER AND CAB2.DHTIPOPER = TOP2.DHALTER) LEFT JOIN TSICUS CUS2 ON CAB2.CODCENCUS = CUS2.CODCENCUS WHERE ITE2.PENDENTE = 'S' AND ITE2.STATUSNOTA = 'L' AND ITE2.CODPROD = PRO.CODPROD AND CAB2.TIPMOV = 'O') AS COMPRA FROM TGFPRO PRO LEFT JOIN TGFEST EST ON PRO.CODPROD = EST.CODPROD LEFT JOIN TGFPAR PAR ON PRO.CODPARCFORN = PAR.CODPARC WHERE (PRO.CODGRUPOPROD = :P_GRUPOPRODUTO OR :P_GRUPOPRODUTO IS NULL) AND (PRO.CODPROD = :P_CODPROD OR :P_CODPROD IS NULL) AND (/*EST.ESTOQUE IS NOT NULL AND */PRO.ATIVO = 'S') AND (EST.CODLOCAL = :P_LOCAL OR :P_LOCAL IS NULL) AND (:P_CODPARC IS NULL OR PRO.CODPARCFORN = :P_CODPARC) AND (:LOCALIZACAO IS NULL OR PRO.LOCALIZACAO LIKE TO_CHAR('%' || :LOCALIZACAO || '%')) GROUP BY PRO.CODPROD, PRO.AD_CODANTERIOR, PRO.DESCRPROD, PRO.CODVOL, PRO.ESTMIN, PRO.ESTMAX, PAR.CODPARC || '-' || PAR.RAZAOSOCIAL, PRO.LOCALIZACAO ORDER BY PRO.CODPROD

grid.title: Reservas realizadas
grid.expression: SELECT ITE.NUNOTA, CAB.DTENTSAI, CAB.AD_NUMPS, ITE.CODPROD, PRO.DESCRPROD, PRO.CODVOL, (ITE.QTDNEG - ITE.QTDENTREGUE) AS RESERVADO, TOP.DESCROPER, CUS.DESCRCENCUS FROM TGFPRO PRO LEFT JOIN TGFITE ITE ON PRO.CODPROD = ITE.CODPROD LEFT JOIN TGFCAB CAB ON ITE.NUNOTA = CAB.NUNOTA LEFT JOIN TGFTOP TOP ON (CAB.CODTIPOPER = TOP.CODTIPOPER AND CAB.DHTIPOPER = TOP.DHALTER) LEFT JOIN TSICUS CUS ON CAB.CODCENCUS = CUS.CODCENCUS WHERE ITE.PENDENTE = 'S' AND ITE.STATUSNOTA = 'L' AND ITE.CODPROD = :A_CODPROD and CAB.TIPMOV = 'J' and (ITE.CODLOCALORIG = :P_LOCAL OR :P_LOCAL IS NULL) ORDER BY ITE.NUNOTA

grid.title: Compras Pendentes
grid.expression: SELECT ITE.NUNOTA, CAB.DTENTSAI, ITE.CODPROD, PRO.DESCRPROD, PRO.CODVOL, (ITE.QTDNEG - ITE.QTDENTREGUE) AS PENDENTE, TOP.DESCROPER FROM TGFPRO PRO LEFT JOIN TGFITE ITE ON PRO.CODPROD = ITE.CODPROD LEFT JOIN TGFCAB CAB ON ITE.NUNOTA = CAB.NUNOTA LEFT JOIN TGFTOP TOP ON (CAB.CODTIPOPER = TOP.CODTIPOPER AND CAB.DHTIPOPER = TOP.DHALTER) LEFT JOIN TSICUS CUS ON CAB.CODCENCUS = CUS.CODCENCUS WHERE ITE.PENDENTE = 'S' AND ITE.STATUSNOTA = 'L' AND ITE.CODPROD = :A_CODPROD and CAB.TIPMOV = 'O' ORDER BY ITE.NUNOTA
